title: Enna Mayam Seithai
desc: Nikhil, a youngster, plays video games and impresses women on social media. However, his life turns upside down when he tries to meet Rags, a game developer.

title: Pa. Pandi
desc: Pandian Pazhanisami, a retired man, misses his youthful days and embarks on a mission to find his first love and reconnect with her.

title: Taanakkaran
desc: Arivu and his trainee friends face the wrath of a ruthless trainer, Eshwaramurthy, who later plots schemes to demotivate and punish the entire batch.

title: Asuran
desc: A farmer goes on the run with his family as he is compelled to protect his son, who has murdered a wealthy upper-caste landlord in a fit of vengeance.

title: Jaya Janaki Nayaka
desc: Gagan, a brave young man, is unable to be with Sweety, his true love, due to her parents' disapproval of him. However, he vows to protect her after unknowingly saving her from gangsters.

title: Mirai
desc: When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.

title: Maari 2
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Shyam Singha Roy
desc: A director accused of plagiarism finds a transcendental connection to his past life when he digs deeper into his subconscious mind.

title: Gouravam
desc: Arjun reaches his friend Shanmughan's village, only to find out that he has eloped with Pasupathy's daughter. So, Arjun, along with his friends and Yazhini, a lawyer, sets out to find the couple.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Kadavul Padaitha Manidargal
desc: The lives of two mortal orphans undergo a series of upheavals thanks to a quarrel between Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Vishnu. It all begins when the two mortals are caught in the drama of a don's life.

title: Silukkuvarupatti Singam
desc: Police constable Shakthi prefers a laid back approach to his job and tries to actively stay away from danger. But he is forced to change this attitude when he inadvertently jails a wanted don.

title: Gandhi Kannadi
desc: An event organizer orchestrates a grand diamond jubilee for an elderly gentleman. This profound assignment facilitates an unexpected journey involving sentimental aspirations and sincere bonds.

title: Good Night
desc: Mohan, an IT employee, has a perennial snoring problem. Later, when he gets married, his issue strains his marital relationship.

title: Kaariyavadhi
desc: A shrewd man runs a market to solely reap its profits. Soon, a young man falls in love with his daughter and stands against his authoritative rule.

title: Siruthai
desc: Rocket Raja, a small-time thief, comes across a young girl who calls him father. However, when Raja finds the truth about the girl's past, he turns into a vigilante.

title: Veerabali
desc: A happy-go-lucky man is forced to adopt violent means to avenge his parents' ruthless murders. So, with the help of his love, he sets out to punish the culprits.
